priorityList: Use Counterspell to interrupt enemy casts as needed.
Channel Evocation if mana is below 10% and Arcane Surge is nearly ready to be used.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary combat cooldown to begin your burst window.
Use Touch of the Magi (off-GCD) while Arcane Surge is active, or if Arcane Surge is on cooldown for more than 30 seconds.
Activate offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows for maximum impact.
Cast Arcane Orb to generate Arcane Charges, prioritizing it when you have fewer than 4 charges or are facing 4 or more enemies.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you have 4 Arcane Charges and Arcane Salvo has reached 20 stacks.
Cast Arcane Barrage at the very end of Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi if you have 15 or more Arcane Salvo stacks.
Use Arcane Missiles when Clearcasting is active to build Arcane Salvo stacks, but avoid using it if Salvo is already at 15-20 stacks.
Use Presence of Mind to cast instant Arcane Blasts when you are at low Arcane Charges and Arcane Orb is unavailable.
Cast Arcane Pulse whenever 3 or more enemies are present to generate Splinters and charges.
Use Arcane Blast as your filler to build Arcane Charges when Arcane Orb and Arcane Pulse are on cooldown.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges as a filler to reset your rotation when not in a burst window.
